title: Waterfront House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the serene coastal community of The Preserve at Inlet Beach, this luxurious four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom beach house offers the ultimate getaway experience. Designed with relaxation in mind, the open living room and well-appointed kitchen set the stage for unforgettable moments from the moment you arrive. The fully fenced backyard, complete with a covered porch, expanded patio, and fire pit, provides a private oasis where you can unwind in style. Pet-friendly and equipped with a golf cart, this home ensures that every member of the family, including the furry ones, can join in on the fun. Complimentary golf each day and a selection of bikes invite you to explore the stunning surroundings.

Features: Bikes Cable TVGolf cart Hair dryer
